# A02-S06: Project development

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

Great you have contact with them :-) I think we should aim for an agreement from March through August then. Maybe also good to get some distance from Celestium, as I want to produce some content as soon as possible. I have an idea for a system of media channels that can provide an organic development in the project, so the AI can in a way work its way towards taking political responsibility and not just launching it from a point zero. (That also gives a role to Computer Lars, for whom I have a lot of material ready!).

It would be great to start with some IRL meetings in the organization (you, [████], [████], [████], etc.), so I can get maximum synergy on the presentation and your current setup. Maybe you can forward that invitation as well? :-)

I want to on Tuesday, but it's especially due to corona a bit short notice. [████] I also have a meeting in Aarhus early Wednesday morning. But I'll try to make it work. Would it be possible to hold some of the above meetings Monday and Tuesday?

A talk Friday morning would suit me best? But maybe we should bet on Monday - IRL or Zoom - when you know more about 'the other project'? :-) I'm always curious about new projects!

All the best!
